arb.text: Harborgate is lost, as Xorin and Sharuum learn from a scout, with twenty-seven missing and much etherium gone.

Agatha and Callio, stranded on Harborgate, try to snare floating dead bodies to salvage their etherium, and Callio kills a Bant aven scout with her crossbow, so Agatha realizes her sister is a Seeker.

Callio reveals that her daughter Jaria was lost and that the Seekers need etherium, and when she integrates etherium into the dead aven and Agatha refuses to help, Agatha shoots and kills Callio and swims to the shore of Jhess.
